description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing tags and tag groups within the Coocook project. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting tags and tag groups, as well as generating related URLs and handling permissions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Tag
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing tags and tag groups in the Coocook application.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for navigation related to tags and tag groups.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of tags grouped by tag groups, including 'other' tags not assigned to any group.

methods.name: new_tag
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a new tag, including URL and available tag groups.

methods.name: index_tag_group
methods.description: Lists all tag groups with URLs for editing each group.

methods.name: new_tag_group
methods.description: Prepares URL for creating a new tag group.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag by ID and stores it in the stash for further processing.

methods.name: tag_group
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag group by ID and stores it in the stash.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag, including related articles, dishes, recipes, and URLs for update/delete actions.

methods.name: edit_group
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag group, including its tags and URLs for update/delete actions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a tag if it is deletable, then redirects.

methods.name: delete_group
methods.description: Deletes a tag group if it is deletable, then redirects.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new tag, optionally associating it with a tag group.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag with new data.

methods.name: update_group
methods.description: Updates an existing tag group with new data.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Handles redirection after create/update actions, directing to the appropriate page.
